book.title: First They Killed My Father: A Daughter of Cambodia Remembers
book.description: Chronicles the brutality of the Khmer Rouge in Cambodia, from the author's forced ''evacuation'' of Phnom Penh in 1975 to her family's subsequent movements from town to town and eventual separation.
